mapper.select: SELECT t.*, req.nickname AS requester_name, prov.nickname AS provider_name FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN user_profiles req ON req.user_id = t.requester_id LEFT JOIN user_profiles prov ON prov.user_id = t.provider_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT t.*, req.nickname AS requester_name FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN user_profiles req ON req.user_id = t.requester_id WHERE t.status = 'OPEN' AND t.deadline > NOW() ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
